text:
maria: Quick heads-up: PR #3412 touches a small rename and a formatter exemption. planning to land in today's merge window if no blockers. pinging for owners/approvals.

sam: Can take a look now. CI shows one lint failure though.

ci-bot: CI failed — gofumpt check
```
Diff found in pkg/parser/parse.go: extra spacing on imports
```

priya: I'm fine with exemption for generated code, but prefer a narrow exempt comment not a repo-level ignore. could you isolate the file?

maria: Yep, it's a generated shim under internal/gen. I'll add a //gofumpt:skip on the file header and push. Also doing the rename in the same PR; ok to squash?

ben: Assigning reviewers: @sam @priya. If tests pass can we merge at 16:00 PT? I'm out after that window.

sam: +1. I'll fix the gofumpt diff and force-push. Prefer squash to keep history tidy.

dave: Quick nit: rename `x` -> `reqID` is fine, but can we use `requestID` to match elsewhere? small follow-up ok.

maria: I'll change to requestID to match existing conventions. Will ping when CI is green. thanks :thumbsup:

sam: Got the fix locally, pushing in 2m.

ci-bot: CI succeeded: all checks passed.

ben: Approved. merge when ready :rocket:

maria: Merged and squashed — thanks everyone. Follow-up PR to update a couple call sites incoming.
